headline: Microchip job posting combines full-chip mixed-signal verification with LLM-assisted debug and test work
fact: Microchip’s Senior Engineer I – Verification posting R1497-26 describes full-chip SoC/mixed-signal verification with SystemVerilog/UVM, analog-IP interactions and coverage closure, plus LLM-assisted code/stimulus generation, root-cause analysis, log/waveform triage and failure clustering. A November 4 Senior Engineer II role R4346-26 names the Chennai WIPD group and adds Verilog-A/AMS and SV-RNM models, SPICE and applicable silicon correlation for ADCs/DACs, PLLs, LDOs, bandgaps and clocking circuits, alongside AI-assisted verification, modeling and debug methodology. The related mandates are grouped without assuming a shared team or completed AI deployment; the later posting does not change this Event’s original year-only date.

sources.title: Microchip Careers: Senior Engineer I – Verification (R1497-26)
sources.summary: The official Microchip requisition describes the full-chip AMS scope, RNM preference, and LLM-assisted stimulus, debug, waveform-triage, failure-clustering, experimentation, and EDA-integration mandate; it exposes only relative posting age, so this Event uses year precision.

sources.title: Microchip Careers: Senior Engineer II – AMS Verification (R4346-26)
sources.summary: Official public Workday startDate is November 4, 2026. Full duties name WIPD in Chennai, HDL behavioral models, SPICE/applicable silicon correlation and AI-assisted verification/modeling/debug workflows. A shared direct team with R1497-26 is not established.
